intro: Reseda sits in the heart of the west Valley along Sherman Way and Reseda Boulevard, with some of the Valley's best family-run Vietnamese and Lebanese cooking in its strip malls.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A beloved vegan Vietnamese restaurant with bold flavors and owners who will happily order for you.
places.o: The lemongrass banh mi and the peanut soup, or ask Kevin to pick.

places.w: A tiny spot serving Northern and Southern Vietnamese specialties you rarely see in the Valley.
places.o: Banh xeo, egg rolls and the dill fish.

places.w: A warm, family-run Lebanese restaurant with generous portions and very fresh food.
